svg.aria-label: A parabola with its focus F, a line a focal length behind its vertex, and the aperture plane in front. For two surface points P, the feed-to-surface leg equals the dashed run from P back to the line, so each ray's whole path equals the straight distance from the line to the aperture plane, the same for every ray
